Thanks for sending the redlines. Appreciate the clarity on the committee's priorities. High-level response: we can be flexible on notice windows and financial caps provided we preserve predictable capacity planning for the Dedicated pool that will serve Acme. Proposed compromises:

- Auto-renew: keep 12-month term with an auto-renew, but allow a 90-day opt-out notice instead of 180; OR switch to a fixed 12-month term with a one-time option to not renew at the end of term with 60 days' notice.
- TFC (termination for convenience): accept a capped TFC equal to 4 months of committed monthly recurring charges (MRC) + 30 days of transition support (technical handoff and KV cache purge).
- Notice windows: operational notice for service-impacting changes remains 30 days; contract non-renewal/termination to follow the agreed notice above.

I'll loop in our Legal to draft counter-language that threads the operational protections in (capacity, ramp-down, and data preservation). If that sounds workable, I'll send the counter redline tomorrow.

Elena —

Appreciate the patience while we looped legal. Per our conversation, please find the final agreed points below and the DocuSign link to execute the Order Form: https://app.docusign.com/rooms/acme-redwood-20270912

Summary of agreed positions:
- Term & Auto-renew: 12-month initial term. Order Form will auto-renew for successive 12-month terms unless Acme provides written notice of non-renewal at least 90 calendar days prior to the end of the then-current term.
- Termination for Convenience (TFC): Acme may terminate for convenience with 90 calendar days' notice. TFC liability is capped at the lesser of (a) four (4) months of monthly recurring charges (MRC) or (b) $250,000. Any pre-paid credits will be pro-rated and refunded per the Order Form refund schedule.
- Transition & Capacity: Redwood will provide up to 30 days of remote transition support at no additional charge and offer a 60-day paid ramp-down option to release Dedicated GPU reservations (pricing in Order Form appendix).
- Notices: All notices under the Order Form must be in writing and sent per the MSA notice section; calendar days will govern notice periods.

Attached: final order form (redwood_acme_orderform_docusign_20270912.pdf) — please review and sign via DocuSign by EOD Sep 16 to keep the pilot schedule intact. If procurement wants the monetary cap adjusted, we can review but any increase will require additional finance signoff.

Thanks and looking forward to getting you onboarded.
